confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Orlando tourist pricing, with no live listings checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely with July peak demand and I-Drive/theme-park proximity. The US has no formal hostel or hotel registration, so 'registered' is read as a licensed, operating property. Cocktail and wine were set from beer using typical US tourist-area ratios (about 1.75x and 1.5x). The FX value is from an RBA homepage search snippet whose labels were jumbled, so it was not verified directly on rba.gov.au and may not be the latest published observation.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other large US theme-park and leisure destinations (for example Anaheim and Las Vegas Strip-adjacent areas), adjusted for Orlando's July peak season and heavy tourist-area pricing.
